card.name: Cross-reference brackets and table pointers
card.fires_on: The opening bracket before "see ..." cross-references at the end of a clause, and small words like "in" or "the" just before a table or section pointer such as "in Table 1" or "described elsewhere in the labeling".

modes.label: Bracket before see
modes.description: The "[" that opens a "[see Drug Interactions (7.x)]" style cross-reference after a statement.

modes.label: In before a table
modes.description: The word "in" or "the" that leads into a reference to a table or other part of the label.

card.plain: It marks the spot in a drug label where the text is about to point the reader to another section or table.
